newsitem.title: USA: Chart Industries outlook good, sets stock buy.
newsitem.headline: Chart Industries outlook good, sets stock buy.

text.p: Chart Industries Inc said Tuesday it will purchase up to one million shares of its common stock, or about 10 percent of its outstanding common shares.
"We believe the company is well positioned for future growth," Chief Executive Arthur Holmes said.

Holmes said the company has a healthy backlog and demand for its engineered products is strong. He said the company is "aggressively pursuing programs to generate further internal growth as well as growth through strategic acquisitions."

"Because of this positive outlook, we strongly believe that the stock of Chart Industries represents an outstanding investment opportunity at this time, and a stock purchase program is in the best interest of our shareholders," Holmes said.
Chart Industries makes industrial equipment. Its stock up 1/4 late Tuesday morning at 16-5/8.
